# CalcTree

> CalcTree turns engineering calculations into API-callable tools. A page is a calculation graph that evaluates server-side with real units. This repo gives your AI the skill to discover pages in a workspace, execute them with custom inputs, and build new ones.

Read the skill first. It covers the tool-use workflow (discover, introspect, execute) and the page-building path, verified against the live API.

## Start here

- [CalcTree skill](skills/calctree/SKILL.md): auth, using pages as tools, the write path, MDX calculation syntax, formula rules, and the authoring rules that decide whether a generated page reads correctly.

## Install

- [Skill zip](https://github.com/calctree/calctree-skills/releases/latest/download/calctree.zip): the latest release, for upload to claude.ai or the Claude desktop app. Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add calctree/calctree-skills`.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version.

## Working code

- [Primitives](skills/calctree/scripts/calctree_api.py): page listing, page-context reads, simpleCalculate (tool execution), page creation with tree registration, MDX content insert, calculation writes, CSV dataset uploads, template listing, cross-page references. Standard library only, importable or a CLI.
- [GraphQL reference](skills/calctree/REFERENCE.md): every operation with its variables and response shape, for driving the API without running our code.
- [End-to-end example](skills/calctree/examples/smoke_two_page.py): creates two linked pages and reads the computed values back.

## Notes

- One `x-api-key` covers reads, page creation, tool execution (`simpleCalculate`) and content writes. An invalid key surfaces as a bare `"Unexpected error."`.
- To use a page as a tool: `pages` → `context` → `simpleCalculate` with scope overrides.
- Dataset variables (VLOOKUP) are not in the `simpleCalculate` scope.
- A page must be registered in the page tree or it is orphaned and invisible.
- Evaluation is asynchronous: settle about two seconds after a write before reading.
